function_v0.doc: The address holding the venue's admin role.
function_v0.name: admin

function_v0.doc:
Transfer the admin role to `new_admin` (current admin only). Deployment hands the role to
the governance timelock once the venue is wired, which is what puts `set_aggregator`,
`set_flash_receiver`, `set_account_wasm` and both `upgrade`s behind the Sensitive delay \xe2\x80\x94
governance classifies any unlisted method as Sensitive, so no per-setter code is needed
here. Without this the venue would be stuck on its deployer key for good: no handover, and
no rotation if it leaks.
function_v0.name: set_admin

function_v0.doc: The configured swap aggregator, if any.
function_v0.name: aggregator

function_v0.doc:
Bind this venue to one Blend `pool`. `owner` is the broker (lock-borrow); every mutating
entrypoint requires its auth. `admin` (deployer / gov) binds the swap aggregator and
wires the flash receiver. `account_wasm` is the installed `blend-borrow-account` code new
positions are deployed from.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc: The `blend-borrow-account` a handle maps to (also its collateral custodian).
function_v0.name: subaccount_of

function_v0.doc: The wired flash receiver, if any.
function_v0.name: flash_receiver

function_v0.doc:
Leveraged open through Blend's flash: flash-borrow `borrow_amount`, have the receiver sell
the stake for collateral through the swap aggregator along `swap_xdr` and forward the
borrowed IRS margin to `margin_to`, then supply \xe2\x80\x94 the flash is left standing as the debt.

The whole flash dance lives here rather than in the broker: the venue owns its receiver and
its aggregator, so the broker stays venue-agnostic and only carries the route through.
function_v0.name: open_leveraged

function_v0.doc:
Set the swap aggregator a leveraged open sells borrowed debt through (admin-gated).

One address for the whole venue, not one per asset pair: routing is the aggregator's job,
and it takes the route with the call. What stays admin-gated is *which contract* is trusted
to receive the stake \xe2\x80\x94 the route only chooses a path through it.
function_v0.name: set_aggregator

function_v0.doc: Set the `blend-borrow-account` wasm hash future positions deploy from (**admin**-gated, like\nthe other config setters). Existing subaccounts are upgraded separately via\n[`Self::upgrade_subaccount`].
function_v0.name: set_account_wasm

function_v0.doc: Blend has a flash loan, which is what leverage here is built on \xe2\x80\x94 so, yes.
function_v0.name: supports_leverage

function_v0.doc: Wire the `blend-flash-receiver` this venue primes for leveraged opens (admin-gated). Set after\nconstruction because the receiver is deployed *owned by this venue*, so its address cannot be\na constructor argument without a deployment cycle.
function_v0.name: set_flash_receiver

function_v0.doc:
Upgrade the venue-owned flash receiver through its only reachable authorization path.

The receiver requires this venue's contract address to authorize `upgrade`, while this
relay is gated by the venue's admin (governance in production). Existing receivers need no
migration because their stored owner is already this venue.
function_v0.name: upgrade_flash_receiver

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Venue-side position snapshot. Every field is a by-product of the single valuation pass
a health read already performs, so a snapshot costs no cross-contract calls beyond that
read; a venue that cannot produce a field in the same frame leaves it zero. Base values
are in the venue oracle's base units (the scale cancels out of `health`, so it is
venue-defined and only ratios of base values are portable); factors are the venue's
native risk weights in the venue's native scale (Blend: 7-decimal `c_factor`/`l_factor`;
Alula: bps `close_ltv`/`liability_factor`; XOXNO: not exposed, `0`).
udt_struct_v0.name: VenueSnapshot

udt_struct_v0.doc:
A Unix timestamp in WAD-scaled seconds (`seconds * 1e18`), the EVM
`Time.blockTimestampScaled` convention. Distinct from [`Wad`] so a point in time is
never mistaken for a duration: timestamps only compare and subtract (yielding a
[`Wad`] duration).
